name: RWBY: DAY OUT
source:
This fanfic is Ruby x Cardin-centric. The story is heavily inspired by a fanfic story of RWBY called "A Rose in Pain". 

[From [url=https://allforone124.itch.io/rwby-day-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部同人小说以鲁比x卡丹为中心。这个故事的灵感很大程度上来自于RWBY的同人故事《痛苦中的玫瑰》。

[来自[url=https://allforone124.itch.io/rwby-day-out]Itch.io[/url]]
